title: Adding values
info: Add the numbers on the notes and coins. That sum is what you have.
If the price is higher than your sum, you need more. If your sum is higher, you can get change.

questions.q: A 20 note and a 5 coin make
You have 50. The snack costs 35. You have

options: money you get back when you pay more than the price
1000 poisha only, which would be 10 taka

questions.q: Type the sum of 10 and 10 and 5.
